label: a_sch_office03_eve01
text: Didja know? When you look into a Pokémon’s\neyes, you can tell what it’s thinking.

label: a_sch_office03_eve04
text: If your Pokémon get injured, you can bring them\nhere to the nurse’s office to get healed up.

label: a_sch_office03_eve07
text:
I come here to take a breather when I’m feeling
down about stuff from class.\c
Nurse Miriam always lets me stay without making
me explain or anything. She’s so nice.

label: a_sch_office03_ni01
text: The students call Nurse Miriam “Mimi”!\nI tried using that nickname with her once...\r\nbut she just glared at me.

label: a_sch_office03_ni03
text: Flaaffy looks so cute when it’s sleeping! Look at\nit! Look at its face!\c\nSO SLEEPY AND CUTE!
